evidenceRule: No acceptance status advances solely because documentation or simulated tests pass.

acceptedArchitecture: Supervisor to A2A Investigation Planner; VM specialist and observability specialist planned

steps.title: Discovery & reconciliation
steps.value: Read-only inventory reconciles the approved JAWS DEV resources without changing cloud state.
steps.evidence: DEV reconciliation remains the accepted evidence. Installer 0.4.10 Discover supports an empty subscription and offline Pester passed. A fresh-subscription discovery receipt has not been recorded, so greenfield Step A is not accepted.

steps.title: Foundry foundation & packaging
steps.value: An approved plan can create a Foundry account, project, model deployment, Key Vault, registry, project identity pull role, and a digest-pinned hosted Supervisor.
steps.evidence: Code and offline CLI-stand-in tests cover Preflight, Install, and Accept. Provisioning, functional acceptance, and customer installation are not recorded. The plan digest binds names and model, not an unbounded cost.

steps.title: Supervisor → Investigation Planner
steps.value: Supervisor v5 returns a completed, read-only VM diagnostic plan through an identity-protected A2A prompt planner.
steps.evidence: Closed DEV: Supervisor v5, planner v1, TASK_STATE_COMPLETED; hosted investigation runtime did not execute.
